origin.description: Test whether the skewness of a normal sample is zero.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector of length 8 to 46340 after missing values are dropped.

origin.details: The skewness is transformed to a normal z. The default p-value is two times the upper tail, folded back when that exceeds 1. less reports the upper tail and says the data have positive skewness. greater reports one minus that tail.
origin.value: An htest with the skewness, its z, and the p-value.
